_doc: scripts.aerial.engine config for Exotics Racing LVMS (ledger 0088 validation). Data only. The circuit is painted on a parking lot: its edges are the painted edge lines (edge_kind lines), the guide runs between them (route_mask between_lines). No published map is on disk and Kevin drew no sketch, so the route is a degraded stand-in sketch made from the 2026-10-28 trace (tools/aerial_engine_validate.py exotics-sketch: a vertex every 30 m, each moved +-3 m): it selects the asphalt; it is never a coordinate. Direction clockwise as the config's route._orientation_doc infers it.
name: Exotics Racing Las Vegas (unofficial)

edge_band._sampled: 2026-11-07 on naip_2019_exr.png cross-sections: the edge bands read yellowness (r+g)/2-b of -18..+5 at lum 138-178; the track asphalt +13..+16, the lot +8..+13, the dark rubbered line +1..+6 at lum 73-78
